BombVault: the only backup & disaster-recovery tool you need for Unraid

Your Unraid data, sealed in a vault and armed with a fuse.

   

What is this?

BombVault is a single-binary web app for Unraid that does one-click backup and full disaster recovery of your Docker containers, KVM/libvirt VMs and the Unraid flash, with restic underneath. The restore is where it shines: a backed-up container shows up in the Docker tab again and a VM in the VM Manager, exactly as it was, even after you deleted it. You don't reinstall or reconfigure anything by hand. Backup paths, encryption, schedules and retention are all set in the web UI, which follows your system's light or dark preference, so there is no config file to edit.

Highlights

  • Three domains in one app: Docker containers (appdata and definition), KVM/libvirt VMs (disks, XML and UEFI NVRAM), and the whole Unraid flash (/boot)
  • A restore that reinstalls for you: containers are replayed against the Docker API and VMs are defined again in the VM Manager, so they come back as they were
  • VM backup without a libvirt mount: BombVault runs virsh on the host over SSH (qemu+ssh://), so it cannot get in the way of your VM Manager. Choose between graceful shutdown and live snapshots through the guest agent
  • Off-site repos through rclone (Backblaze B2, S3, Google Drive and more) or SMB/NFS. The rclone config is stored encrypted
  • Retention by keep-last, daily, weekly and monthly, pruned automatically after each backup
  • File-level restore: browse a container snapshot and put a single file back where it came from
  • Integrity checks (restic check) and pre/post-backup hooks, for example mysqldump for an app-consistent backup
  • Incremental and deduplicated backups, encrypted unless you switch encryption off, and a check for IP and port conflicts before a restore
  • Scheduling per domain, HTTPS out of the box, an optional password, and a UI in English and German
  • Multi-arch (amd64 and arm64). Image: ghcr.io/junkerderprovinz/bombvault:latest

Requirements

  • Unraid 6.12+
  • The template mounts the Docker socket, your storage root (/mnt) and the flash (/boot) for you. Backup sources and destinations both live under /mnt, and you pick the exact subpaths in the WebUI
  • An APP_KEY is required. Generate one with openssl rand -hex 32. The restic password is derived from it, so keep it safe: without it, encrypted backups cannot be recovered
  • VM backup is opt-in. It talks to libvirt over SSH, so you authorize BombVault's key on the host once (Settings → VM Backup over SSH shows a command to paste and a Test button). No libvirt mount is needed
  • Trusted LAN only: through docker.sock and the /mnt mount, BombVault has root-equivalent control of your host. Keep it off exposed networks. Password protection is in Settings and is off by default

Companion: BombVault Widget (dashboard tile)

BombVault Widget is a small, optional Unraid plugin (not a container) that puts BombVault's activity log on the Unraid 7 dashboard as a native tile. It shows every backup, restore, verify, prune, off-site replication and drill as it happens, plus the next scheduled run, in the same dark terminal-style log. It can only read: it reaches BombVault through a same-origin proxy with a widget token that never gets to the browser. Install it from Community Applications (search for BombVault Widget) or with one click from BombVault → Settings → System → Dashboard widget. It needs BombVault ≥ 6.9.0. The widget has no support thread of its own, so post widget questions here too.

Posting a bug report

Please post:

  • Unraid version (Settings → System Information)
  • Image tag (latest or a pinned vX.Y.Z)
  • Output of docker logs --tail 200 BombVault
  • Which domain (containers, VMs or flash) and what you were doing (backup or restore)
  • For VM issues: the result of Settings → VM Backup over SSH → Test connection
  • Your browser and OS

GitHub issues with the same information are welcome as well: github.com/junkerderprovinz/bombvault/issues

Credits

The core idea, one-click backup and automatic reinstall of Docker containers, comes from VolumeVault by @Darkdragon14 (Apache-2.0). BombVault is an independent rewrite in Go on top of restic that extends the idea to VMs and the Unraid flash. It is built on restic (engine) and rclone (off-site). If BombVault saves your bacon, you can buy me a coffee.

Self-hosted and MIT-licensed. BombVault has root-equivalent control of your host: you run it, so your data and the responsibility are yours.
